description: Subscription of upready-store to the JSON-UI engine developed in app-shell. app-shell has no release-updates channel as of 2026-09-06: a release is a package publish to GitHub Packages with a provenance git tag @ivanprotsko-org/<pkg>@<version> (app-shell CLAUDE.md, Publish policy) and the only plan document is docs/ROADMAP-JSON-UI.md. This record is what the architect of upready-store checks at the start of every session; the delta goes into the HANDOFF status and lastSeen is updated in the same turn.

producer.publishPolicy: CLAUDE.md § Publish policy — publish is NOT a gate (Ivan, 2026-09-05)

roadmapSlices.note: slice 4 = whole app screens from JSON; phase 3 of the store program depends on it

commands: git ls-remote --tags $(git -C /Users/ivanprotsko/upready/projects/app-shell remote get-url origin) '@ivanprotsko-org/*' | sed 's/.*refs\/tags\///; s/\^{}$//' | sort -u > /tmp/as-tags.txt; node -e 'const s=require("/Users/ivanprotsko/upready/projects/upready-store/specs/design-system/app-shell-subscription.json");console.log(s.lastSeen.tags.sort().join("\n"))' | diff - /tmp/as-tags.txt && echo 'tags: no new'

grep -hoE '"@ivanprotsko-org/[a-z-]+": *"[^"]+"' /Users/ivanprotsko/upready/projects/upready-store/apps/storefront/package.json /Users/ivanprotsko/upready/projects/upready-store/package.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'pins: none yet (step 0 T0g installs the first)'

git -C /Users/ivanprotsko/upready/projects/app-shell log --oneline 502179a..HEAD -- docs/ROADMAP-JSON-UI.md docs/APPUISPEC.md specs/component-contracts/contract.schema.json packages/renderer/package.json packages/upready-ui/package.json packages/block-gen/package.json
check.then: Delta present → one line in `handoff.mjs status set`, update lastSeen (commit, tags, checkedAt) in this file, and if the contract schema or AppUISpec changed → re-validate specs/design-system/wrapper-contract.schema.json mapping (field appShell.mapping of every contract).
